infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EnergyGuard JRB uses the microphone so the crew can talk through the job. You can type instead.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EnergyGuard JRB uses your location to record the job site location on a Job Risk Briefing when you choose to use location services.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: EnergyGuard JRB uses location services to record the job site location on a Job Risk Briefing when location access is enabled.
